about: The structure of scene narration: the setting kinds, the cause label prefixes and the word that joins several names. It holds no sentences; openings are the moves that open a scene (its first role's move), each narrated by the bank's opening sentences; they come from the mined bank (data/english/parts/scene-words.json) through src/director/mined/scene-bank.ts. A setting or cause the bank has no sentence for is left out.
